records.question: Erin works in the school cafeteria serving soup. Each bowl of soup has 10 ounces, and Erin can serve 5 bowls per minute. If the pot of soup has 6 gallons of soup, how long will it take Erin to serve all the soup, rounded to the nearest minute? (There are 128 ounces to a gallon.)
records.response:
There are 6*128 = 768 ounces of soup in the pot.
If each bowl of soup has 10 ounces, then Erin must serve 768/10 = 76.8 bowls of soup.
If Erin can serve 5 bowls per minute, then it will take her 76.8/5 = 15.36 minutes to serve all the soup.
Rounded to the nearest minute, it will take Erin 15.36 minutes to serve all the soup.
#### 15.36

records.question: Bill's roof can bear 500 pounds of weight. If 100 leaves fall on his roof every day, and 1000 leaves weighs 1 pound, how many days will it take for his roof to collapse?
records.response:
The leaves fall on his roof at the rate of 100 leaves per day.
The leaves weigh 1000 leaves / 100 leaves / day = 10 pounds / day.
The roof can bear 500 pounds, so it will take 500 pounds / 10 pounds / day = 50 days for his roof to collapse.
#### 50
